entry.teaser: During the meeting, the ministers discussed the strong and growing Canada-Vietnam trade and investment relationship, noting that Canadian merchandise exports to Vietnam increased by 30.2% in 2025. They also spoke about opportunities to deepen commercial cooperation in key sectors, such as energy, aerospace, agriculture and agri-food...
entry.title: Minister Sidhu meets with Vietnam’s Minister of Industry and Trade

entry.teaser: Building the strongest economy in the G7 requires the full and equal participation of women. Through the Women Entrepreneurship Strategy (WES), the federal government is helping more women entrepreneurs access the financing, training and networks they need to succeed as we build a stronger, more competitive Canada.
entry.title: Minister Valdez launches call for proposals for the Women Entrepreneurship Strategy Ecosystem Fund
